title: Episode
description: The single source of truth for one video. Flows through script, narration, render, mux and CI unchanged.

series.description: by-the-numbers = essays (hand-written), every-level = ladders (data swap), the-price-tag = rankings (data swap).

title.description: Final YouTube title. Follows the series' title grammar.

slug.description: Filesystem/URL-safe name. Defaults to id if omitted.

market.description: Primary target market. Drives currency, spelling and framing.

language.description: Channel/video language and caption convention. One convention, never mixed.

durationTargetMin.description: Target runtime in minutes. Never under 10.

hold.description: Optional scheduling intent (CI does not upload; this is a note to you).

voice.description: Narration voice config for this episode.

chapters.description: Ordered chapters. Each becomes a YouTube chapter marker. Titles carry the figures.

figures.description: Every number shown on screen, with its source. Referenced by id from chapters.

sources.description: Master source list, printed in the video description.

ledger.description: Running-totals strip config (net worth, debt, years).

track.description: Which figure field the ledger accumulates.

calculator.description: The 'see your own numbers' asset linked at the end. Doubles as email capture.

thumbnail.description: Thumbnail override. Default is generated from the same code: character + 3-word serif headline + red spiking line + year.

title.description: Chapter marker + on-screen heading. For ladders/rankings, carries the dollar figure.

scriptFile.description: Path (relative to episodes/) to a hand-written .md script for this chapter. Used by essays.

script.description: Inline narration text. Used when a scriptFile is not supplied (ladders/rankings).

bubble.description: Short punchy line the mascot says in a speech bubble.

figures.description: Figure ids shown during this chapter, in order of appearance.

animation.description: Per-chapter visual direction: what the stick figure does and what the chart shows.

clip.description: Name of a 2D mocap clip in tools/mocap/clips (e.g. 'walk', 'fall', 'point'). Produced from BVH/FBX.

figures.description: Figure ids plotted, in draw order.

drawSeconds.description: How long the chart takes to draw itself in, synced to narration.

props.description: Doodle props placed around the scene, popping in staggered.

source.description: Id of the entry in the top-level sources array that backs this number.

accessed.description: YYYY-MM-DD when the number was pulled.

quote.description: Exact sentence to highlight on the source card, if any.
